The '''Journeyman Tool Box''' was a [[starship tool kit]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. A neatly organized box, it contained one of nearly every kind of tool needed to repair [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="PSG" />
